ANSWERS.Q1: Yes on both counts, and the direction is right. The rewritten limb stays strictly inside PAPER 042's own evidence — presence and 'abbondanza non determinata' from that record's own clinical-relevance field (one individual, three passages, declared visual inspection, no densitometry, no statistic), and 'binding al peptide PPPY severamente compromesso' is the R4's own direction sentence about that paper. It imports nothing from Hussain (the 'due oligopeptidi' numeral that failed v1 is gone) and nothing the R4 refused: no 'retains', no 'residual' in any form, no 'PPxY', no per-construct claim in either direction. Moving the claim to the fence is right: the fence at mechanism_intervention_map.md:336 carries the audit's own wording adopted rather than paraphrased, while the claim carried wording two independent passes withdrew — when a derived surface and a canonical row disagree and the derived one is the audited one, the canonical row is the error. This is also precisely the act the second verification named as its own WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_MY_MIND at Site 3, so its objection there evaporates on landing.
ANSWERS.Q2: Withdrawing the rule is CORRECT and not patchable — a single-variable rule naming stimulus is falsified inside its own cited paper, since the ex-vivo positive is under MRSA, an infectious stimulus, with asterisks on all three analytes. And the two-variable statement does NOT over-read what two papers support: I attacked it as instructed and the attack failed against the source. I expected 'mechanical, whole-animal -> positive' to be a cultured-cell result, which would have made SYSTEM rather than stimulus the real separator; PMID38563965.md item 6 settles it — BAL IL-6, KC, IL-1β and MCP-1 all significantly higher in VILI-exposed KO mice, Fig 5, every panel with a significance bracket, n = 10 per group. Whole animal. Had I reported the objection I would have called for deleting a true statement to obey my own error. One qualification in the direction of saying MORE: E3 lists three of four cells and omits mechanical x isolated ECs -> positive; the full 2x2 shows the null is the SINGLE cell (infectious x whole-animal), also the lowest-powered, and that isolated cells are positive under BOTH stimuli — so compartment is the more reliable of the two separators and the bound gets stronger, not weaker.
ANSWERS.Q3: Yes to both, and yes, E12's retraction still makes its point. They are the right KIND of repair for a canonical record: each replaces an assertion in the record's own voice with the attested facts and their stated limits, neither reproduces the withdrawn wording in any voice (no repair-by-quotation at either site), and neither touches a quotation of a source. E13 in particular fixes the field-to-field self-contradiction the second verification identified, which is the same defect class as CLAIM 007's Title against its Summary. E12's retraction stands on the domain argument alone — verified by reading the whole Note rather than the delta: 'un'altra lesione in un altro dominio', 'comparator model', 'non un banco read-across', 'nessuna prova su un missenso SDR sepolto può passare di lì' and the MECHANISM_TRANSFER_FIREWALL pointer all survive untouched, so the non-equivalence stops depending on the disputed abundance fact. Two qualifications: E12 under-claims the binding lesion and should carry a degree word for consistency with E2, E10 and the fence; and both are substring edits whose surrounding field content must survive, E13's especially.
ANSWERS.Q4: Transcription: faithful in substance, with two omissions from the R4's OWN wording — the '~2.5% of the wild-type lane's integrated density' figure and 'Nothing in the paper quantifies the mutant signal or measures it as zero.' Both measurements: KEPT, and I checked each against the R4's measurement table — lane 2 'not strictly blank' (mean 153.25 vs 157.87 background, 4.62 deficit at 2.2 px-sd, coherent over ~110x25 px) and lane 4 'empty within measurement' (-0.24). The deleted material is exactly the refused inference and nothing else. On the dispatcher's own judgement: HALF RIGHT. 'Absoluteness qualified' must go — it is the per-construct qualification the R4 refused in as many words ('No narrowing of either claim's absolute is proposed on this evidence'). 'Direction unaffected' must STAY: it is true and it is the sentence the R4's boundary wording closes on. Deleting it would delete a true statement to obey a verification result — the 🔴 rule's error arriving by compression rather than vocabulary — and would leave the bullet ending on pure agnosticism, the exact condition the R4's own section 7 says tempts a reader to resupply the refused inference.
ANSWERS.Q5: The thirteen: adequate as an interim disposition, NOT as a horizon. Declaring beats the silent drop, the enumeration is complete and I verified all thirteen lines myself. But §21e T0 is explicit that 'declared debt' and 'queued' are not permitted resting states for an implementable change, and these are implementable now — both ledgers are non-canonical and scientist-writable, need no BATCH_COMMIT, and the replacement wording already exists at six other sites. Ownership uncertainty is not 'cannot be implemented at all'; it is a question §21d just answered. So: declare them in the batch report AND dispatch the repair task in this session, with the BLOCK-1 gate on the therapeutic ledger's four. entries[19]: leaving it to the contradiction procedure is correct, and I verified the premise by running the audit rather than believing it. I add one thing the packet could not: the second verification reached the OPPOSITE reading of 'severe phenotype' at that site (defensible as the mouse, which is severe), so the field carries a live inter-pass disagreement — a further reason it needs its own R4 rather than a free edit.
ANSWERS.Q6: MINOR still holds, and touching two PAPER Notes does not disturb it. Note is an annotation field, not a claim assertion; no PAPER Status, Evidence depth, Claim links or identity field moves; CLAIM 006 and CLAIM 007 keep consolidated baseline and CLAIM 030 keeps in observation. Annex D's CHANGE_CLASS vocabulary is ORDINARY | MAJOR and MINOR is the working-model version step (WM_v4.7 -> v4.8), consistent with 003. The MAJOR precedent (BATCH_20260806_001) was MAJOR because it deleted a medication caution; no delta here removes safety language, reverses a baseline, moves a status or touches BLOCCO 1. Every delta is a narrowing within existing strength or the deletion of a refused inference. No fresh R4 is owed for any of E10-E14 (stated though not asked): none introduces a reading, a new proposition or a persisted-locator change, and E14 cannot need an audit to remove what the audit refused.
